world.setting: A city at night in the rain, seen through small interiors.
world.period: The present day; phones exist but nobody looks at one.
visual_rules: Practical light only: desk lamps, street light through windows.
continuity_rules: It rains through the whole film.

characters.name: The Filmmaker
characters.description: A director at the end of a long career, guarded and tired.
characters.appearance: A man in his late forties, lean, unshaven, grey at the temples, deep-set eyes.
characters.wardrobe: A dark wool coat over a black sweater.
continuity_notes: His coat is wet from the rain.

characters.name: The Interviewer
characters.description: A patient journalist who has saved her hardest question for last.
characters.appearance: A woman in her thirties, short black hair, round glasses.
characters.wardrobe: A grey blazer, a notebook always in hand.

locations.name: A small office
locations.appearance: One table, two chairs, a rain-streaked window, a single desk lamp.
forbidden_changes: The window is behind the interviewer.

props.name: The notebook
props.description: Where the interviewer keeps her questions.
props.appearance: A small black notebook with a red elastic band.
